name: Shadow Spike Strike
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level cleric/oracle 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 30 feet
Area 30-ft. line
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a vile flurry of shadowy spikes, which blast from your hand in a line. The line deals 1d6 negative energy damage per caster level (maximum 15d6).

HD	Effect
10 or more	Deafened
5-9	Deafened, nauseated
4 or less	Dazed, deafened, nauseated
